method.notes: One persistent process/slot per backend, fresh per session. Alternating order (also rotated with three backends), discarded warmups, all raw samples retained. Nearest-rank median/p95; firstCalls are not necessarily cold startup. Native round trips include host JSON encode/decode. Oracle creation and parity checks are outside timing. The 1,000-row report service and production schedules under 60 periods use synchronous calculations under every label. Production-service rows include actual host validation, dates and result shaping. Exact preview/budget APIs are distinct from production numeric policies. No database is opened; full CSV, bank review, posting and API latency are not measured.
